description: The crew debuted custom-made sun visors added to the EVA suits, improving comfort and visibility during sunny-condition traverses.
response: Visors were fabricated and fitted by a crew member before the day's EVA and used successfully in the field.
lesson: Custom sun-visor fabrication is a low-cost, high-value suit modification for high-Arctic summer sun angles; consider adopting it as standard EVA suit kit rather than an ad hoc, single-crew improvisation (compare the same class of fix independently reinvented by Crew 15 in 2023).
